evidence_level: Conditional calculations only, not simulation or measurement
regulated_quantity: LED current; voltage follows LED load. Approximate 20-series 3V LED load only.

input_bulk_startup.pulse_qualification: NOT established by continuous 2W rating; manufacturer FW datasheet does not establish this sub-ms pulse from energy alone. Required before powered acceptance.

output_overvoltage.reason: Optocoupler and reference delays are typical only; limit is an acceptance test requirement, not a proved bound.

ref_open_fault.condition: Output held at or below85V by functioning OVP; not the failed-short main-switch fault

thermal.note: These are test stop criteria, not predicted temperatures. Actual board temperature and efficiency remain unmeasured.

failure_scope.main_MOSFET_short: The positive buck has no independent series disconnect. Output can receive rectified mains when main switch fails short. No fail-safe/product safety claim.
failure_scope.surge: Old MOV/surge acceptance is not inherited; no surge waveform test authorized.
failure_scope.initial_energization: Requires a qualified guarded test setup and separate documented test acceptance.

fabrication_scope: Unpowered bare laboratory PCB only; these calculations do not themselves approve CAD or manufacturing.

opto_feedback_authority.primary: LinkSwitch-TN2 family datasheet Rev Q June2023, control tables pp11-12 and Note C
opto_feedback_authority.interpretation: 55uA is in the MIN column, visually checked against primary p12. This supports the manufacturer BP-to-FB optocoupler topology. Table limits at25C are not an independently proved all-temperature loop/delay guarantee; verify actual hot regulation and fault response.

input_bulk_independent_discharge.basis: 1% initial tolerance plus100ppm/K maximum over an illustrative80K deviation; primary Vishay20035 rating1W at70C,500V end-to-end operating;300V against ambient is separate, no unrelated copper underbody.
input_bulk_independent_discharge.limits: Healthy resistor only. Verify actual voltage and discharge in the qualified fixture before handling; a waiting time is not proof of zero voltage or single-fault redundancy.

copper_screen.limits: Legacy external-trace empirical screening only, coarse at low temperature rise; does not include component heating, laminate tolerance, planes or airflow. Not a predicted complete-board temperature or physical verification.
